content.value_statement: Document workflows often need several tools for DOCX, PDF, and PPTX files. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical steps for reading, creating, editing, converting, and validating common office documents.
actual_capabilities: Reads Word documents by converting DOCX files to Markdown with pandoc.
Creates DOCX files with docx-js examples and local output files.
Extracts PDF text and tables using pdfplumber workflows.
Merges and splits PDF files with pypdf or qpdf examples.
Creates, edits, rearranges, and validates PowerPoint files through PPTX and OOXML workflows.
Converts DOCX, PPTX, PDF, and image outputs using tools such as LibreOffice, poppler, and pandoc.
limitations: It provides workflow guidance and examples, not a bundled document editor.
It depends on external tools and libraries being installed in the local environment.
Complex OOXML edits require careful validation before sharing documents.
OCR quality depends on scan quality and installed OCR dependencies.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Reports
use_cases.description: Create polished DOCX or PDF reports from structured notes, tables, and generated text.

use_cases.title: Process Document Archives
use_cases.description: Extract text, split files, merge PDFs, and convert documents into easier review formats.

use_cases.title: Build Presentation Drafts
use_cases.description: Generate PPTX slides, rearrange decks, validate thumbnails, and apply consistent layout rules.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple format conversion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this DOCX file to Markdown, preserve headings and lists, and tell me which command or tool you used.

prompt_templates.title: Extract PDF Content
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for text and table extraction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the text and tables from this PDF. Keep page numbers, separate tables from prose, and flag pages where extraction looks unreliable.

prompt_templates.title: Assemble a Report Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow across Word and PDF outputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a report package from these notes. Produce a DOCX draft, export a PDF version, and list validation checks for layout and missing content.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an OOXML Presentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for controlled PowerPoint edits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Unpack this PPTX, update the specified slide text and speaker notes, validate the edited OOXML, repack the file, and generate thumbnails for review.

output_examples.input: A DOCX report needs to become Markdown while keeping tracked changes visible.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a pandoc workflow with tracked changes enabled, then reviews the Markdown output for headings, lists, and revision markers.

output_examples.input: Several PDFs need to be merged and split into selected page ranges.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines pypdf and qpdf approaches, creates a merged output, and produces separate files for requested page ranges.

output_examples.input: A presentation draft needs slide rearrangement and visual validation.
output_examples.output: The skill describes the slide order workflow, repacks the presentation, and uses thumbnail validation to check the final deck.

best_practices: Keep original documents unchanged and write edited versions to clear output filenames.
Validate converted files visually before sharing them with others.
Install only the document tools needed for the current workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not run conversion commands on untrusted files without reviewing the environment risk first.
Do not overwrite the only copy of an important document during edits.
Do not assume OCR output is accurate without manual review.

faq.question: Does this skill edit Word documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains DOCX reading, creation, and OOXML-based editing workflows.

faq.question: Can it work with PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers text extraction, table extraction, PDF creation, merging, splitting, and image conversion.

faq.question: Can it create PowerPoint files?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes HTML to PPTX workflows, slide editing, slide rearrangement, and thumbnail validation.

faq.question: Are the required tools included?
faq.answer: No. The skill lists tools and libraries that must be installed separately in the local environment.

faq.question: Does it preserve tracked changes?
faq.answer: It shows how to make tracked changes visible during DOCX conversion and gives OOXML patterns for insertions and deletions.

faq.question: Is this suitable for scanned documents?
faq.answer: Yes, when OCR dependencies are available. Accuracy depends on scan quality and language support.
